title: Codadka Khaaska ah ee ku xiga Nebi
intro: Dhul fog, rasuul sharaf leh ayaa la kulmay diidmo adag oo ka timid awoodihii xukunka hayay wakhtigaas. Haddana waxaa ag taagnaa addoonkan Alle, oo aad u xiiseynaya inuu ka jawaabo baaq rabbaani ah. Go'aankooda aan la leexleexan karin wuxuu kala qaybin doonaa qaran awood leh ugu dambayntiina wuxuu ka adkaan doonaa ciidamada gaalnimada.
clues: Waxaan ahayn koox yar oo daacad ah, oo ku midaysan iimaan iyo ujeedo.
Waxaan ag taagnay rasuul sharaf leh oo ay diideen mas'uuliyiinta awoodda badan ee dhulkooda.
Markii rasuulkani weydiiyay, 'Waa kuma taageerayaashayda jidka Alle?' ayaan si aan shaki lahayn ugu jawaabnay.
Waxaan weydiisannay rasuulkan inuu ka raadiyo casho cirka ka timid si uu qalbigeenna ugu qanciyo.
Dadkii wakhtigaas jiray qaarkood waxay rumaysteen farriinteenna, kuwa kalena way diideen, laakiin Alle wuxuu xoojiyay mu'miniinta.
Annagu waxaan nahay Hawwariyiintu — xertii Ciise ee daacadda ahayd, oo lagu guuleystay taageerada Eebbe.

identity.label: Kumaan ahay?
options: Hawwariyyun (Xerta Ciisaha)
Asxaabta Godka
Xaaska Mu'miniinta ah ee Fircoon
Qoyska Boqortooyada ee Saba
Saaxiriintii rumaysnaa maxkamaddii Fircoon.

trial.label: Tijaabo/Dhacdo
options: Ballanqaad daacadnimo ah oo ah taageerayaasha hawsha nebi
In lagu ilaaliyo hurdo god xiran gudahiisa
In lagu tuuro god ololaya iimaan awgiis
Ka badbaashada shirqool xasuuq ah markii ay dhallaan ahaayeen
Markhaati ka noqoshada badaha kala go'a iyadoo uu amray nebi
trial.answer: Ballanqaad daacadnimo ah oo ah taageerayaasha hawsha nebi

location.label: Qaybta Muhiimka ah
options: Miis lagu faafiyay cunto jannada ka timid oo cirka ka timid
Markab si rabbaani ah loo dhisay oo ku dul nasanaya buur buur ah
Ul cunay sixirka kali-taliyayaasha
God lagu shaabadeeyay ilaalin rabbaani ah
Hashii ka soo baxday dhagax adag
location.answer: Miis lagu faafiyay cunto jannada ka timid oo cirka ka timid

outcome.label: Natiijo
options: Waxaa laga dhigay kuwo ka sarreeya kuwii diiday farriinta
Si nabad ah ayay u seexatay saddex boqol oo sano
Waxaa laga badbaadiyey biyihii daad weyn
Wuxuu arkay markii la qarqiyay taliye dulmi badan iyo ciidankiisii
Dahab iyo khasnado aan la soo koobi karin ayay urursadeen laakiin kibir baa baabi'iyay
outcome.answer: Waxaa laga dhigay kuwo ka sarreeya kuwii diiday farriinta

arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كُونُوٓا۟ أَنصَارَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَا قَالَ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ لِلْحَوَارِيِّـۧنَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَـَٔامَنَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ مِّنۢ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَكَفَرَت طَّآئِفَةٌۭ ۖ فَأَيَّدْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ عَدُوِّهِمْ فَأَصْبَحُوا۟ ظَـٰهِرِينَ
verse: O you who have believed, be supporters of Allāh, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, "Who are my supporters for Allāh?" The disciples said, "We are supporters of Allāh." And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant. (61:14)
